verdict.rationale: The SOS public pages offer a business database search and certificate-of-good-standing validation. These let a founder see an entity's standing, but the evidence does not document a tracker for the status of a pending filing or application. The pack's only explicit status checker, the refund lookup on tax.colorado.gov, covers state income tax returns rather than business filings. Missing for 10: documented lookup of pending business-filing or application status, case/complaint status tracking, details of what the business search shows, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
